title: AG60082: Instrumentation And Research Techniques
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Principle of measurements. Measurement of physical, rheological, mechanical,
electrical properties of agricultural materials. Measurement of temperature,
pressure, humidity, moisture content, velocity, discharge, force, torque,
strain and displacement. Strain and stress relationship. Strain sensitive
transducers. Principle and selection of transducers. Signal conditioning. Data
acquisition systems. Data analysis and statistical interpretation.
